nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native loose Git object storage, canonical commit header parsing, Git tree entry parsing/serialization, and loose direct/symbolic reference parsing and storage.

wordpressScenario: Git-backed WordPress content workflows, package installs, Playground snapshots, and server-side repo primitives; current examples parse a WordPress deploy tree and write/read HEAD plus deployment branch refs without shelling out to git.
